POST /shipments/{id}/customs-hold.name: Hold a shipment for customs
POST /shipments/{id}/customs-hold.summary: Staff can stop a shipment and record why customs is holding it.

POST /exports/sftp/schedule.name: Nightly export to SFTP
POST /exports/sftp/schedule.summary: Yesterday's shipments arrive on the client's SFTP server every night, with no one clicking anything.

POST /exports/s3/schedule.name: Nightly export to S3
POST /exports/s3/schedule.summary: Yesterday's shipments arrive in the client's S3 bucket every night, with no one clicking anything.

GET /portal/shipments.name: Customers see their own shipments
GET /portal/shipments.summary: Globex's customers can log in and see their own shipments without contacting support.

POST /portal/shipments/{id}/issue.name: Customers report a problem
POST /portal/shipments/{id}/issue.summary: A customer can report a problem with a shipment, which opens a support ticket.
